text_ja: 連結自己資本規制比率は、最終指定親会社を連結財務諸表提出会社(連結財務諸表の用語、様式及び作成方法に関する規則(昭和五十一年大蔵省令第二十八号。以下「連結財務諸表規則」という。)第二条第一号に規定する連結財務諸表提出会社をいう。)として作成された連結財務諸表に基づき算出するものとする。ただし、最終指定親会社が銀行又は銀行法第五十二条の二十三第一項第一号から第十号まで若しくは第十五号に掲げる会社を子会社(法第二十九条の四第四項に規定する子会社をいう。以下この項において同じ。)としている場合における当該子会社(以下「金融子会社」という。)については、連結財務諸表規則第五条第二項の規定を適用しないものとする。
text_en: The Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio shall be calculated based on consolidated financial statements prepared with the Ultimate Designated Parent Company treated as a company required to submit consolidated financial statements (meaning a company required to submit consolidated financial statements as provided in Article 2, item (i) of the Regulation Concerning Terminology, Forms, and Preparation Methods of Consolidated Financial Statements (Ministry of Finance Ordinance No. 28 of 1976; hereinafter referred to as the "Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation")); provided, however, that where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company has, as a subsidiary (meaning a subsidiary as provided in Article 29-4, paragraph (4) of the Act; the same applies in this paragraph), a bank or a company listed in items (i) through (x) or item (xv) of Article 52-23, paragraph (1) of the Banking Act, the provisions of Article 5, paragraph (2) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation shall not apply with respect to such subsidiary (hereinafter referred to as a "Financial Subsidiary").

refs.external_item_summary_ja: 「連結財務諸表提出会社」（連結財務諸表の提出義務を負う会社）を定義する規定。
refs.external_item_summary_en: Defines "a company required to submit consolidated financial statements" — the term borrowed here to identify who this scope-of-consolidation rule applies to.

refs.external_item_summary_en: Lists the specific categories of companies a bank holding company may hold as subsidiaries — e.g. a Long-Term Credit Bank, a securities-specialist company, an insurance company, a trust-specialist company, and foreign companies conducting those businesses.

refs.external_item_summary_en: Defines "subsidiary" as another company of which a company holds a majority of the total shareholders' voting rights — the definition borrowed here to identify which entities count as a subsidiary of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company.

refs.external_item_summary_ja: 重要性の乏しい子会社を連結範囲から除外できる、という一般ルール。この告示はこのルールを金融子会社には適用しない（＝重要性を問わず必ず連結対象とする）としている。
refs.external_item_summary_en: The general rule letting immaterial subsidiaries be dropped from consolidation. This notification disapplies that rule to Financial Subsidiaries — meaning they must always be consolidated regardless of materiality, closing what would otherwise be a loophole.
